about.title: Better growing starts
about.description: Herbanol is a biotechnology-driven agricultural company creating sustainable agricultural products from local resources.
about.mission: To provide high-quality, biotechnology-based agricultural inputs that enhance productivity, reduce reliance on imports, and support sustainable farming.
about.vision: To lead the region in sustainable agricultural substrates and innovative biotech solutions that strengthen food security and promote environmental resilience.
about.support: Agriculture, biotechnology, and environmental sustainability—working together.

valueNotes.quality: A focus on high-quality growing media.
